messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a self-contained SVG with reasonable drawing: bicycle (wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals), pelican body, big beak with pouch, wing, eye, legs on pedals. Let me carefully construct coordinates.

Canvas: 600x500.

Bicycle: wheels at (180, 380) and (420, 380), radius 60. Frame connecting. Pelican sits above seat around (300, 250).

Let me draft:

Wheels: circles with spokes. Frame: lines from rear wheel hub to seat tube, down tube to front hub, top tube, handlebar.

Pelican: body ellipse around (300, 260), neck curving up to head around (350, 170), beak extending right with pouch. Wing on body. Legs going down to pedals.

Colors: pelican white/gray body, orange beak/pouch.

I'll produce it as a code block with the SVG. Reasonably detailed but not huge.

Frame geometry:
- Rear hub: (160, 380)
- Front hub: (420, 380)
- Bottom bracket (pedals): (290, 380)
- Seat tube top: (275, 270)
- Head tube top: (390, 270)

Lines: rear hub→bottom bracket, rear hub→seat top, bottom bracket→seat top, seat top→head top, bottom bracket→head top (down tube), head top→front hub, handlebar at head top extending.

Seat at (275, 265). Pelican body sits above seat, ellipse centered (295, 235) rx 65 ry 45, tilted slightly. Tail pointing back-left. Neck from (330, 210) curving up to head (375, 155). Head circle r ~22 at (378, 150). Beak: long from (398, 145) to (480, 160), pouch hanging beneath beak (a bulging curve). Eye at (382, 143).

Wing: ellipse on body.

Legs: from body bottom (300, 275) to pedal crank at (290, 380): pedal crank circle at bottom bracket r 15, pedal positions (275, 365) and (305, 395). Legs as bent lines.

Handlebar at head top (390, 270): bar going up to (400, 250) then grips. Wing/wrap? Pelican's wing could reach handlebar—but keep simple.

Add ground line, maybe clouds optional. Keep moderate.

Spokes: lines through hub.

Let me write final SVG.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 500" width="600" height="500">
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <rect width="600" height="500" fill="#bfe3f4"/>
  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="520" cy="70" r="35" fill="#ffd94d"/>
  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="440" width="600" height="60" fill="#8fbc7f"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="440" x2="600" y2="440" stroke="#6b9a5c" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- ===================== BICYCLE ===================== -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <!-- Frame -->
    <line x1="160" y1="380" x2="290" y2="380"/> <!-- chainstay -->
    <line x1="160" y1="380" x2="275" y2="270"/> <!-- seat stay -->
    <line x1="275" y1="270" x2="290" y2="380"/> <!-- seat tube -->
    <line x1="275" y1="270" x2="390" y2="270"/> <!-- top tube -->
    <line x1="290" y1="380" x2="390" y2="270"/> <!-- down tube -->
    <line x1="390" y1="270" x2="420" y2="380"/> <!-- fork -->
    <!-- Seat post and handlebar -->
    <line x1="275" y1="270" x2="272" y2="255"/>
    <line x1="390" y1="270" x2="400" y2="245"/>
    <line x1="380" y1="245" x2="420" y2="245"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Seat -->
  <path d="M 255 255 Q 272 248 292 255 Q 280 262 258 262 Z" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <g fill="none">
    <circle cx="160" cy="380" r="60" stroke="#333" stroke-width="8"/>
    <circle cx="420" cy="380" r="60" stroke="#333" stroke-width="8"/>
    <g stroke="#888" stroke-width="3">
      <line x1="100" y1="380" x2="220" y2="380"/><line x1="160" y1="320" x2="160" y2="440"/>
      <line x1="118" y1="338" x2="202" y2="422"/><line x1="118" y1="422" x2="202" y2="338"/>
      <line x1="360" y1="380" x2="480" y2="380"/><line x1="420" y1="320" x2="420" y2="440"/>
      <line x1="378" y1="338" x2="462" y2="422"/><line x1="378" y1="422" x2="462" y2="338"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="160" cy="380" r="6" fill="#333"/>
    <circle cx="420" cy="380" r="6" fill="#333"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Crank & pedals -->
  <circle cx="290" cy="380" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="290" y1="380" x2="272" y2="362" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="262" y="356" width="20" height="8" rx="2" fill="#555"/>
  <line x1="290" y1="380" x2="308" y2="398" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="300" y="396" width="20" height="8" rx="2" fill="#555"/>

  <!-- ===================== PELICAN ===================== -->
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M 240 225 L 195 205 L 205 235 L 190 240 L 235 250 Z" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Legs (behind body) -->
  <g stroke="#e8862e" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M 300 270 L 285 320 L 272 360"/>
    <path d="M 320 275 L 315 330 L 308 394"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Feet on pedals -->
  <path d="M 260 358 L 285 358 L 282 368 L 262 368 Z" fill="#e8862e"/>
  <path d="M 300 396 L 322 396 L 320 406 L 302 406 Z" fill="#e8862e"/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="238" rx="68" ry="46" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#c9c9c9" stroke-width="3"
           transform="rotate(-8 300 238)"/>

  <!-- Wing -->
  <path d="M 270 220 Q 320 205 340 240 Q 305 265 268 245 Q 260 230 270 220 Z"
        fill="#dcdcdc" stroke="#b5b5b5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 280 232 Q 305 228 325 242" fill="none" stroke="#b5b5b5" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M 330 215 Q 355 195 365 160 L 388 165 Q 378 205 352 232 Z"
        fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#c9c9c9" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="380" cy="152" r="24" fill="#f5f5f5" stroke="#c9c9c9" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Beak with pouch -->
  <path d="M 398 140 Q 450 132 485 148 Q 470 152 455 154 L 400 158 Z"
        fill="#f2a94b" stroke="#d98a2b" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M 402 156 Q 440 195 478 152 Q 450 172 415 166 Q 405 163 402 156 Z"
        fill="#f6bd6b" stroke="#d98a2b" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="382" cy="145" r="5" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="384" cy="143" r="1.8" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Wing reaching to handlebar -->
  <path d="M 345 235 Q 375 230 398 244" fill="none" stroke="#c9c9c9" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Scarf for flair -->
  <path d="M 340 200 Q 320 210 290 205 L 288 215 Q 320 220 344 212 Z" fill="#d64550"/>
</svg>
```

A pelican (complete with signature pouch beak and a little red scarf) pedaling along on a sunny day. Paste the code into an `.svg` file or an HTML page to view it. Feel free to tweak colors or proportions!
